_comment: Exp 40 plan-F FULL-BUDGET RESUME (2026-05-18, founder-directed). Resumes the converged plan-F run from its round-6 checkpoint and runs the FULL 20-round budget to observe how far gamma depletion actually gets if the run is NOT stopped early by the zero-critical arm. INSTRUMENTATION-ONLY changes vs the original plan-F config, NOT gamma changes and NOT cooking: (1) gamma_alt_consecutive_zero_crit 3 -> 999 disables ONLY the zero-novel-CRITICAL early-stop arm (the exact trigger that pre-empted plan-F at R6; the founder is testing whether it stopped the run prematurely). (2) earliest_stop_round 3 -> 20 prevents the main state-convergence gate from pre-empting the gamma observation before budget. gamma_alt_threshold stays 0.30 UNCHANGED so a legitimate gamma>=0.30 success is still detected and stops the run (that is the win condition we WANT to observe). The gamma estimator and threshold are untouched -> the measure remains real and falsifiable; only competing early-stops are removed so gamma's full 20-round trajectory is visible. All previously-agreed non-cooking fixes remain in place unchanged (A collision-overwrite fix in code; B in-round re-ask; C apply-fixes-back full-suite-gated; G7). NO gamma-hardening (dual-series/critical-gate) is applied here -- that awaits the founder ruling and would be the cooking-risk change; deliberately excluded.

_convergence_criteria.description: Gate passes if gamma-alt fires (gamma >= 0.30 OR 3 consecutive rounds with 0 novel CRITICAL). With the small finite slice + apply-back loop the error space can exhaust, so a genuine convergence is now reachable rather than re-injection-dominated. Wall-clock cap is a safety net, not the expected termination path.
_convergence_criteria.pass_condition: gamma >= 0.30 OR (3 consecutive rounds with 0 novel CRITICAL findings).
_convergence_criteria.fail_condition: Any model fails to produce parseable output in 2+ consecutive rounds.

_payload_note: Slice ~4K chars, no context files. Well under decomposition threshold; monolithic single dispatch to all 5 models. Short rounds by design for live monitoring.
